title: TypeScript Bridge Configuration
description: Configuration for the TypeScript Bridge build integration.

output.description: Configuration for the generated C# output.

className.description: Name of the generated C# static class.

fieldName.description: Legacy single-entrypoint field name; also used in test mode.

bundle.description: Bundler options. The TypeScript target is configured in tsconfig.json.

format.description: Output module format. Use 'iife' for direct <script> embedding.

keepNames.description: Preserve function and class names when mangling. Only applies when level is aggressive.

run.description: Runtime host configuration. Applied when the project is executed.

browser.description: Browser used by the runtime host.

port.description: Port for the debug HTTP host.

entrypoint.description: Name of the application entrypoint used by F5; defaults to main. Ignored in test mode.

isTestProject.description: When true, use the test entrypoint instead of the application entrypoint.

entrypoint.description: Path under ts/ to the application entrypoint.

testEntrypoint.description: Path under ts/ to the test entrypoint.

entrypoints.description: Named application bundles. Ignored when isTestProject is true.

fieldName.description: Unique C# field name in the generated class.

source.description: TypeScript source relative to ts/ (for example src/chart.ts).
